heading: Today
text: Patches of dense valley fog, then partly sunny, giving way to more clouds this afternoon.  A chance of showers south, mostly near and south of the MA border.  Turning less humid.  Highs in the 70s.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Tonight
text: A slight chance of an evening shower south, then becoming mostly clear and cooler.  Areas of dense valley fog.  Lows in the upper 40s and 50s.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Friday
text: Morning valley fog burning off.  Mostly sunny north, mixing with clouds south in the afternoon.  Highs in the 70s.  Winds light and variable.
